items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I did not ever like Red Nichols or Bix Beiderbecke very much.

ctx.x: later you'd find little by little your own ideas would start coming in.

So when I first started to play I copied his solos note for note. And I would copy anybody's solos; but I did not ever like Red Nichols or Bix Beiderbecke very much. And when I went later years -- well, I'll get into that, it became kind of an issue. It was very racially divided in California, musicians were.
Do you recollect that old Italian teacher's name? Just for the record, who taught you to play French horn and --
